newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sappi lifts SD Warren stake to 97 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sappi lifts SD Warren stake to 97 percent.

text.p: South African paper and pulp group Sappi Ltd said on Wednesday it had acquired an additional 22 percent of the shares in U.S.-based SD Warren Holdings, taking its stake to 97 percent.
The agreed purchase price was $138 million based on a price of $17.25 per share.

The company announced in December that it planned to acquire the 22 percent minority interest in Warren, jointly held by DLJ Merchant Banking Partners LP, certain of its affiliates and UBS Capital LLC.
Sappi added it would endeavour to acquire the remaining three percent of Warren and make it a wholly-owned subsidiary.
The 22 percent acquisition is with effect from May 27.
Sappi acquired control of Warren, the largest manufacturer of coated woodfree paper in the U.S., in mid 1995.
The company said that it had agreed to use "reasonable" efforts to acquire the remaining common equity interests in Warren within 120 days following the closing of the acquisition.
Based on current circumstances it is expected that the acquisition of the remaining three percent would be made at a similar price.
